text:
Riley (Support): Escalation: Altura Health (tenant=altura-pvt-21) onboarding blocked. They requested Private deployment (VPC peering) and embeddings return 403/connection refused during ingest. Demo is tomorrow; renewal checkpoint in 8 days. Need CS ownership + expedited provisioning and customer comms. :warning:
Zara (CS): Taking point. Can Support paste the error + peering status? I'll prepare a comms plan and coordinate with Infra and Security.
Riley (Support): Error snippets:
```
POST /v1/embeddings -> 403 Forbidden
{"error":"access_denied","request_id":"req_vpc_42"}
caused by: tcp connect to 10.8.1.12:443 -> connection refused
```
Riley (Support): Peering status in portal shows "pending route acceptance" from customer's side. They claim they've accepted. Also see TLS handshake failures in the logs.
Lin (Infra): Likely two issues: (1) missing route advertised back from customer's VPC (accepted but not propagated), (2) proxy ACL blocking egress to our embed worker subnet. Short term options: A) Host a browser-based demo using hosted endpoint and mask PII, B) expedite peering validation with customer's infra (I can open a runbook call), C) reprovision a dedicated temporary tunnel for demo. I can kick off a tunnel if CS approves. Command to check peering: `infractl vpc status --peer-id altura-pvt-21`
Dev (AM): Demo tomorrow has external clinicians. If demo fails we risk renewal and expansion. We need a safe hosted fallback they can use for demo to avoid private infra delay. Zara, ok to offer hosted demo & a $1000 remediation credit if we fail to provision before demo?
Ava (Security): Heads-up: if we do hosted fallback, we need an approved data handling exception for demo (no PHI in payloads). CS must confirm sanitized demo dataset and sign a temporary DPA addendum. I'll draft the exception and need customer's SOC contact copied.
Zara (CS): Proposed comms plan: 1) Immediate outbound: apology + status + 30-min triage call with customer + Infra in 30m. 2) Offer hosted-demo fallback (sanitized dataset) for tomorrow plus live co-run; ask customer to confirm no PHI will be included. 3) If provisioning completes within 48h, offer $1000 credit and a free 2-hr enablement workshop. 4) Update renewal brief and flag renewal in 7 days for proactive outreach. Dev please confirm credit.
Dev (AM): Confirmed $1000 credit + 2-hr enablement. Use exact wording: "We're sorry for the disruption. If on-prem provisioning is not completed before your demo, we will run your demo on our hosted environment and credit your account $1,000 and provide a 2-hour enablement session." Approved.
Riley (Support): Outreach message sent, customer accepts 30-min triage in 25m. They shared their SOC contact and peering acceptance screenshot.
Lin (Infra): I'm on the runbook call with customer's netops now. Found that they accepted peering but didn't export route table; instructing them to add a route advertisement. Also found an overly-strict egress ACL on our proxy cluster; applying temporary allow for their subnet. Kicking off temporary SSH tunnel for demo as backup.
ProvisionBot: Provision ticket PROV-998 created; status=expedite; assignees=Lin (Infra), Zara (CS); created_at=3101010122
Ava (Security): Drafted data exception template; need CS to confirm sanitized payload and attach customer's SOC email. Zara, please sign off and send to customer for approval.
Zara (CS): I'll run the triage call, confirm workaround, and share the hosted-demo guidelines + data-handling checklist. Action items: - 1) Host triage call (Zara, Riley, Lin) - 2) Send hosted-demo instructions + sanitized dataset template in 1 hour - 3) Send provisioning status updates to customer hourly until complete - 4) Post-provision: send $1000 credit + schedule 2-hr enablement - 5) Flag renewal for proactive contact in 7 days.
Riley (Support): Call complete  peering route accepted, proxy ACL relaxed, SSH tunnel provisioned. Customer agreed to the hosted-demo fallback but prefers final provisioning.
Lin (Infra): Applied temporary ACL rule and validated connectivity to embed workers; TLS handshake now succeeds. We'll keep the SSH tunnel for the demo window and continue peering troubleshooting. I'll mark PROV-998 as high priority.
ProvisionBot: PROV-998 status=in-progress; last_update=3101010149
Zara (CS): Sent hosted-demo instructions + sanitized payload template. Customer confirmed they will scrub data and provided SOC contact. Also scheduled the live co-run for demo time.
Dev (AM): I'll update the renewal brief with mitigation steps and credit pledge. Planning outreach in 6 days to align renewal ask after stability confirmed.
Ava (Security): Received customer's SOC confirmation; data exception approved for hosted-demo only. Please ensure demo logs are purged after run.
Zara (CS): Post-call comms snippet for CRM: "Altura Health onboarding blocked by VPC peering route propagation + proxy ACL. Temporary ACL allow + SSH tunnel applied; hosted-demo fallback agreed and scheduled. If provisioning not completed pre-demo, $1,000 credit + 2-hr enablement to be applied. Renewal flagged for proactive outreach in 7 days. Contacts: Zara (CS), Dev (AM)."
Lin (Infra): Follow-ups: finish peering validation, remove temporary ACL after 24h, and add automation check to detect route propagation issues.
ProvisionBot: PROV-998 status=monitoring; last_update=3101010165
Zara (CS): Marking this mitigated for demo but monitoring provisioning. Will update this thread with final provision completion and credit confirmation. :white_check_mark:
